title: Metric Conformal Prediction via the Conditional Expected Local Radius
abstract: arXiv:2610.31336v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce the conditional expected local radius (CELR) and develop a new conformal prediction method for non-Euclidean responses in general metric spaces. CELR measures local conditional probability concentration, allowing prediction sets to accommodate heterogeneity and multimodality without requiring densities or a vector space structure. Its conditional distribution yields a nonconformity score that is comparable across covariate values and avoids costly transport comparisons between distance profiles. We further adapt a metric distributional random forest that handles multivariate covariates and nonlinear interactions, while a single forest fit supplies all score components, reducing computation by eliminating repeated local fitting. We establish uniform consistency of the estimators and asymptotic conditional validity under suitable regularity conditions, together with finite-sample marginal coverage under exchangeability. Nume

translated_title: 基于条件期望局部半径的度量保形预测
translated_abstract: 我们提出了条件期望局部半径（CELR），并开发了一种适用于一般度量空间中非欧几里得响应变量的新型保形预测方法。CELR 度量局部条件概率的集中程度，使预测集能够适应异质性和多峰性，而无需依赖密度估计或向量空间结构。其条件分布产生了一个在不同协变量取值之间具有可比性的非一致性得分，并避免了距离轮廓之间代价高昂的传输比较。我们进一步改造了度量分布随机森林，使其能够处理多变量协变量和非线性交互作用，同时单次森林拟合即可提供所有得分组成部分，通过消除重复的局部拟合来降低计算成本。我们在适当的正则性条件下建立了估计量的一致性和渐近条件有效性，并在可交换性假设下获得了有限样本边际覆盖率。
tldr: 该论文提出条件期望局部半径（CELR）这一新度量，构建了适用于一般度量空间中非欧几里得响应的保形预测方法，结合度量分布随机森林实现高效计算，并从理论上证明了估计量一致性、渐近条件有效性及有限样本边际覆盖率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the conditional expected local radius (CELR) to develop a new conformal prediction method for non-Euclidean responses in general metric spaces, leveraging a metric distributional random forest for efficient computation, with theoretical guarantees of consistency, asymptotic conditional validity, and finite-sample marginal coverage.
